name: SelectField
summary: A themed native select with an associated label, help and validation messages.

props.name: label
props.meaning: Visible accessible name associated with the select.

props.name: hint / error
props.meaning: Described-by text; error also marks the control invalid. The owning form controls announcements.

props.name: native select props
props.meaning: Includes options as children, value/defaultValue, disabled, id, handlers, ref and ARIA attributes. An omitted id is generated uniquely.

accessibility: Retains native select keyboard behavior and disabled options. Label and help/error IDs are associated; caller-supplied aria-describedby is retained.
usage: Use for a bounded choice. Supply native options and preserve server-owned option restrictions. Match TextField's label/help conventions.

examples.label: Native choice
examples.description: Synthetic options and help; the selection is not saved or sent.
